Convert a dicom_volume Between DICOM LPS and NIfTI RAS World Coordinates

Source: R/dicom-volume.R
to_ras.Rd

Transforms the 4x4 physical world affine and direction cosines of a dicom_volume between the DICOM Patient Coordinate System ("LPS": Left-Posterior-Superior) and the neuroimaging NIfTI standard ("RAS": Right-Anterior-Superior) via diag(c(-1, -1, 1, 1)) %*% affine.

Usage

to_ras(vol)

to_lps(vol)

dicom_to_ras(vol)

dicom_to_lps(vol)

Arguments

vol

A dicom_volume object.

Value

A dicom_volume object in the target coordinate system ("RAS" for to_ras(), "LPS" for to_lps()).

Details

Because det(diag(-1, -1, 1)) == +1 (a 180-degree rotation around the Superior z axis), right-handedness of (d_row, d_col, normal) is strictly preserved without permuting in-memory voxel indices. Both functions are idempotent when vol is already in the target coordinate system.

Examples

aff <- diag(c(0.8, 0.8, 2.5, 1.0))
aff[1:3, 4] <- c(-100, -120, 50)
vol <- new_dicom_volume(array(0, dim = c(8L, 8L, 4L)), affine = aff, coord_system = "LPS")
vol_ras <- to_ras(vol)
vol_ras$affine[1:3, 4]
#> [1] 100 120  50
vol_lps <- to_lps(vol_ras)
all.equal(vol_lps$affine, vol$affine)
#> [1] TRUE
